prompt: Two armored human soldiers in polished steel plate with white tabards, both fully visible head to knee and the same size, lunging forward in unison side by side with swords raised. A single surge of radiant white holy magic forks and strikes both warriors at once, each wreathed in the same bright white empowering glow that swells their muscles with sudden strength. The only source of light is the white magical radiance. The background is a sunlit medieval battlefield with banners.

Two armored human soldiers in steel plate with white surcoats standing back-to-back in symmetric mirrored poses, both fully visible and the same size, weapons raised. A single column of radiant white holy light erupts from the ground between them and splits to envelop both warriors simultaneously, each gilded in the same bright white empowering glow. The only source of light is the white magical column. The background is a dim medieval courtyard at dusk.

Two armored human soldiers in steel plate with white surcoats, both fully visible and the same size, stepping forward and raising their swords with sudden strength. A single burst of radiant white holy magic splits and wraps tightly around each warrior, both their bodies sheathed in the same bright white empowering aura that crackles over their armor. The only source of light is the white magical aura around the two soldiers. The background is a dim medieval courtyard at dusk.

Two allied human soldiers in steel plate and white tabards, both fully visible head to knee and the same size, charging forward shoulder to shoulder toward the viewer. A radiant white bolt of holy magic descends from above and forks into two, one branch slamming into each soldier so both bodies blaze with the same bright white empowering glow surging through their armor. The only source of light is the forking white magic. The background is a sunlit battlefield with distant banners.
